q-1951.name: Question 1
q-1951.worked_solution:
First, we express $f(x)$ as the composite function

$$
f={4}^{u},\,u=7x.
$$

Differentiating gives

$$
\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}u}={4}^{u}\operatorname{ln}⁡4,\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=7.
$$

We now apply the chain rule, and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x} \\  & =7\cdot {4}^{u}\operatorname{ln}⁡4 \\  & =7\operatorname{ln}⁡4\cdot {4}^{u} \\  & =7\operatorname{ln}⁡4\cdot {4}^{7x}.\end{aligned}
$$

q-1951.html:
Question 1
?

If f(x)=47x, find f′(x).

a
7x
b
ln⁡4⋅47x
c
7⋅47x
d
7ln⁡4⋅47x
e
47x
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we express f(x) as the composite function

f=4u,u=7x.

Differentiating gives

dfdu=4uln⁡4,dudx=7.

We now apply the chain rule, and get

dydx=dydu⋅dudx=7⋅4uln⁡4=7ln⁡4⋅4u=7ln⁡4⋅47x.

q-1953.name: Question 2
q-1953.worked_solution:
First, we express $f(x)$ as the composite function

$$
f={e}^{u},\,u={x}^{2}.
$$

Differentiating gives

$$
\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}u}={e}^{u},\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=2x.
$$

We now apply the chain rule and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x} \\  & ={e}^{u}\cdot (2x) \\  & =2x{e}^{u} \\  & =2x{e}^{{x}^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

q-1953.html:
Question 2
?

Find f′(x) for f(x)=ex2.

a
2xex2
b
xex2
c
e2x2
d
2ex2
e
x2
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we express f(x) as the composite function f=eu,u=x2.

Differentiating gives dfdu=eu,dudx=2x.

We now apply the chain rule and get dfdx=dfdu⋅dudx=eu⋅(2x)=2xeu=2xex2.

q-71877.name: Question 3
q-71877.worked_solution:
First we express $f(x)$ as the composite function

$$
f={e}^{u},\,u=2{x}^{4}+3.
$$

Differentiating gives

$$
\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}u}={e}^{u},\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=8{x}^{3}.
$$

We now apply the chain rule, and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x} \\  & ={e}^{u}\cdot (8{x}^{3}) \\  & =8{x}^{3}{e}^{u} \\  & =8{x}^{3}{e}^{2{x}^{4}+3}.\end{aligned}
$$

8xe6x4+1

8x3e2x4+3
c
5x2e2x4+5
d
xex4+3
e
8xe2x+3
Submit
Correct

f=eu,u=2x4+3.
